title: The shelf of big ideas

data.source: Phoenix_Egg/FOUNDATIONS/HISTORICAL_PARITY.md and Phoenix_Egg/README.md in this repository: the table is read and the recorded counts are added up. No experiment is run.

prediction: Nothing in the world is predicted. Phoenix's record, read back: eight frameworks are set beside CRR for their shape, not their standing; of 53 prospective results counted, 16 passed at some rung and none at the top; 0 of 197 retrodictions were sharp; no CRR-specific finding has been replicated.
baseline: The eight frameworks in Phoenix's own table: thermodynamics, information theory, Bayesian inference, dynamical systems, the free energy principle, Whitehead's process philosophy, Growing Block theories of time, and Lakatos's research programmes.
why: A comparison of kinds is not a measurement. Phoenix's own statement is that CRR has more testing discipline than many metaphysical systems and far less confirmation than a mature theory such as thermodynamics. The sums in the picture agree with the record.
phoenix_status: Interpretive. "Parity" means "structural comparison", "not equal evidential status". "no replicated CRR-specific PASS-2 finding"; "every graded result sits at specificity S1 or S2, none at S3"; retrodiction is "compatibility at S1 or S2, not novelty, prediction or confirmation".
